reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs (Section 8 covenants of Client, Section 10 confidentiality) contain no non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-inducement covenant binding the Customer, which matches the preferred position of 'no non-solicit on Customer.'

No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original text, so there is no risk of an invalid or directionally wrong edit.

The two failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) are correctly characterized as inapplicable — they only constrain the content of an existing non-solicit, and their absence cannot prejudice us where no such covenant exists.

Rationale is transparent about the scope of review (term searches for solicit/hire/induce/recruit/personnel) and appropriately flags the separately papered Non-Competition Agreement referenced in § 8(d) as out-of-document paper to be diligenced, without overstating the in-document conclusion.
